summary: Catalog Misthalin geography is directionally correct and does not use the region name as an area (no Karamja-style self-area bug). Equilibrium League wiki now explicitly lists Fort Forinthry, City of Um, Zanaris, Dorgesh-Kaan and Archaeology Campus under Misthalin, so several content rows still labelled historical/pending are stale and should upgrade confidence. Real issues: three area=content name collisions (Fort Forinthry, City of Um, Varrock Dig Site); missing League-notable places Zanaris/Dorgesh-Kaan/Edgeville/Archaeology Campus; missing combat content for Zamorakian Undercity / Zamorak and Senntisten Asylum; a handful of upgrades with clear non-Misthalin geography (Mazchna, Death altar, Attuned ectoplasmator) wrongly regionId'd misthalin; data/league/regions.json still only lists the three starter towns.

fortForinthry.wikiGeography: Player fort N/NE of Varrock at former Grieving Vale; northern gate opens into Wilderness; fort interior not Wilderness-dangerous. Wiki and Misthalin kingdom page treat it as a Misthalin duchy after New Foundations.
fortForinthry.league: Equilibrium League/Areas/Misthalin lists Fort Forinthry under notable settlements. Fort Forinthry page shows Misthalin League region badge ✓.
fortForinthry.catalog: Present as area and again as content with confidence historical_league_taxonomy_pending_equilibrium_confirmation — stale after League page.
fortForinthry.verdict: Keep as Misthalin area. Rename content row. Upgrade confidence to confirmed_equilibrium_wiki.

cityOfUm.wikiGeography: Underworld city; surface portal just north of Draynor lodestone. Necromancy hub (ritual site, Well of Souls, Rasial citadel).
cityOfUm.league: Equilibrium League/Areas/Misthalin lists City of Um. City of Um page shows Misthalin League badge ✓.
cityOfUm.catalog: Present as area; content 'City of Um / Underworld' collides and still pending Equilibrium confirmation.
cityOfUm.verdict: Keep as Misthalin area. Rename content to Necromancy hub framing. Upgrade confidence.

varrockDigSite.wikiGeography: Excavation area east of Varrock at the Archaeology Campus; tutorial/entry for Archaeology; adjacent to Senntisten Dig Site entrance.
varrockDigSite.league: Equilibrium lists 'Archaeology Campus' as notable settlement, not the phrase 'Varrock Dig Site'. Dig Site page still has Misthalin League badge ✓.
varrockDigSite.catalog: Area 'Varrock Dig Site' + content 'Varrock Dig Site / early Archaeology' (inferred_region).
varrockDigSite.verdict: Prefer League name Archaeology Campus as the mapable hub area (or keep Dig Site and add Campus). Disambiguate content title. Confidence can rise to confirmed_wiki / confirmed_equilibrium_wiki.

wizardsTower.wikiGeography: Saradominist magic/RC institute on island south of Draynor; Runespan + Runecrafting Guild portals on roof. Misthalin kingdom page lists it under notable features. League badge Misthalin ✓.
wizardsTower.league: Not on Equilibrium notable-settlements shortlist, but firmly Misthalin and useful planner hub.
wizardsTower.catalog: Area only (no content collision). Upgrade 'Wizards' Tower and Runecrafting Guild' correctly regionId misthalin.
wizardsTower.verdict: Keep as area. Optional content row for Runespan/Runecrafting Guild access if desired.

egwdAndZamorak.wikiGeography: Elder God Wars Dungeon in Senntisten ruins under/at Archaeology Guild; League region Misthalin ✓. Zamorakian Undercity + Zamorak, Lord of Chaos also League-tagged Misthalin on wiki.
egwdAndZamorak.catalog: Kerapac, Arch-Glacor, Croesus, TzKal-Zuk present. Missing Zamorakian Undercity / Zamorak content (and progression upgrade if not under another id).
egwdAndZamorak.verdict: EGWD boss rows OK; add Undercity/Zamorak; bump EGWD confidences off historical-only wording.

issues.finding: Content name 'Fort Forinthry' exactly equals area 'Fort Forinthry'. Same place appears thrice once Fort upgrades (Workshop/Town Hall/etc.) are counted.
issues.wikiEvidence: Fort is a place/settlement (wiki location + Equilibrium notable settlement), not a content product name.
issues.fix: Rename content to something role-clear such as 'Fort Forinthry construction and Slayer hub' (keep area as 'Fort Forinthry'). Leave building-specific upgrades as-is.

issues.finding: Content 'City of Um / Underworld' collides with area 'City of Um'.
issues.wikiEvidence: City of Um is the place; Necromancy/rituals/Rasial path are activities located there.
issues.fix: Rename content to 'City of Um Necromancy hub (rituals / Well of Souls)' or similar. Area stays 'City of Um'.

issues.finding: Content 'Varrock Dig Site / early Archaeology' collides with area 'Varrock Dig Site'.
issues.wikiEvidence: Varrock Dig Site is geography; early Archaeology tutorial/campus use is activity.
issues.fix: Rename content to 'Early Archaeology tutorial (Varrock Dig Site / Archaeology Campus)'. Prefer adding area 'Archaeology Campus' per Equilibrium list.

issues.finding: Equilibrium League Misthalin notable settlements include Zanaris and Dorgesh-Kaan; neither is in catalog areas (or placeAnchors).
issues.wikiEvidence: https://runescape.wiki/w/Equilibrium_League/Areas/Misthalin lists both. Zanaris is entered via Lumbridge Swamp (Lost City) and hosts Cosmic altar + Chaeldar; Dorgesh-Kaan is the underground goblin city under Lumbridge.
issues.fix: Add areas 'Zanaris' and 'Dorgesh-Kaan'. Optionally add placeAnchors (Zanaris near south-west Misthalin / swamp side; Dorgesh under Lumbridge).

issues.finding: Equilibrium combat list includes The Zamorakian Undercity; wiki tags Zamorak, Lord of Chaos as Misthalin. Neither appears in catalog content.
issues.wikiEvidence: Equilibrium League/Areas/Misthalin notable combat; https://runescape.wiki/w/Zamorak,_Lord_of_Chaos League region Misthalin ✓.
issues.fix: Add content rows: 'The Zamorakian Undercity' (elite dungeon) and 'Zamorak, Lord of Chaos' (boss). Add upgrade row for Vestments of Havoc / Bow of the Last Guardian / ability codices if not already present under another region.

issues.finding: Upgrade 'Mazchna / Achtryn (Canifis Slayer Masters)' is under misthalin upgrades.
issues.fix: Move to regionId morytania (or remove from misthalin upgrades if duplicated).

issues.finding: Upgrade 'Death altar (Temple of Light Runecrafting)' is under misthalin.
issues.wikiEvidence: Temple of Light / Death altar is Tirannwn content.
Ectoplasmator / Ghosts Ahoy path is Port Phasmatys / Morytania.

issues.wikiEvidence: Misthalin wiki Communities list: Edgeville, Barbarian Village, Lumford among others.
issues.fix: Add area 'Edgeville' (and optionally 'Barbarian Village' / Gunnarsgrunn). Anchor Edgeville north-west of Varrock toward Wilderness.

issues.finding: Equilibrium lists 'Archaeology Campus'; catalog has 'Varrock Dig Site' only.
issues.wikiEvidence: Equilibrium notable settlements; Dig Site page: dig site is at Archaeology Campus.
issues.fix: Add 'Archaeology Campus' as area (planner hub for Guild + dig site). Keep 'Varrock Dig Site' as area only if map needs the dig field separately; otherwise fold dig site into Campus and keep dig-site wording on content/upgrades.

issues.finding: Senntisten Asylum is on Equilibrium Misthalin combat list; absent from catalog content.
issues.wikiEvidence: Equilibrium League/Areas/Misthalin → Notable combat activities → Senntisten Asylum. Asylum surgeon's ring upgrade already exists under misthalin.
issues.fix: Add content 'Senntisten Asylum' (kind: dungeon / quest challenge). Pair with existing Asylum surgeon's ring upgrade.

issues.wikiEvidence: Equilibrium League/Areas/Misthalin now exists and lists these hubs/activities; individual pages carry Misthalin League badges.
issues.fix: Rewrite confidence to confirmed_equilibrium_wiki (or current_wiki_location_plus_confirmed_equilibrium_league_region). Update data/league/regions.json hardRules/warnings that still say Equilibrium has not published Fort/Um locality.

issues.wikiEvidence: N/A — internal consistency; wiki supports the fuller catalog list plus Zanaris/Dorgesh/etc.
issues.fix: Sync league areas with proposedAreas (or a curated subset used by UI).

issues.finding: Several cross-region / other-region packages sit under misthalin with regionId misthalin: 'Invention Guild named machine room' (Asgarnia), 'Hops patch network (Entrana + run geography)' (Asgarnia-led), plus global Slayer helmet / prefer-block / POH gilded altar / multi-region outfit stacks.
issues.wikiEvidence: Invention Guild is NE of Falador (Asgarnia). Entrana hops are Asgarnia. Global Slayer rewards are not Misthalin geography.
issues.fix: Rehome clear single-region rows (Invention Guild → asgarnia; Entrana hops → asgarnia or cross-region). For true multi-region packages, use a cross-region id / region_hints pattern rather than parking them all on starting Misthalin.

issues.finding: Near-duplicate Thieving tool rows: 'Thieves' Guild master thief tools', 'Master thief's lockpick + stethoscope (toolbelt)', 'Master thief's lockpick + master thief's stethoscope'. Also 'Infernal Source Dig Site' vs 'Infernal Source Dig Site (Zamorakian)'.
issues.wikiEvidence: Single Thieves' Guild under Lumbridge; single Infernal Source dig site north of Varrock.
issues.fix: Merge tool rows into one permanent-tools upgrade + one guild hub upgrade. Keep one Infernal Source dig-site upgrade with Zamorakian collection note in detail.

issues.finding: Wiki communities also list Barbarian Village and Lumford; notable features include Paterdomus/Silvarea, Draynor Manor, Lumbridge Swamp — none required for planner density but useful if expanding beyond League shortlist.
issues.wikiEvidence: Misthalin wiki Communities + Notable areas and features.
issues.fix: Optional: Barbarian Village area only if map density needs it. Do not invent League-only stats.

issues.finding: Catalog does not list 'Misthalin' as an area (unlike karamja listing 'Karamja' as an area).
placeAnchors match current catalog areas exactly (good). After adding Zanaris / Edgeville / Dorgesh-Kaan / Archaeology Campus, anchors will need new UV points.
issues.wikiEvidence: placeAnchors.ts requires area string equality with catalog areas.
issues.fix: Add anchors only for areas that land in proposedAreas.

issues.finding: Sanctum of Rebirth listed as dungeon plus Vermyx / Kezalam / Nakatra individually — same pattern as Asgarnia GWD bosses. Acceptable if UI can nest; not a false geography.
issues.wikiEvidence: Sanctum is entered from City of Um side of Underworld.
issues.fix: Optional UI nesting only; no rename required beyond parent hub collision above.
